'''Joe Steyer''' was a Decipher-era [[Squadron Members|Squadron Member]], listed as Red 57 from Anchorage, Alaska. The published fan table marks the slot Retired after Decipher's SWCCG run.

He grew an Anchorage group from 5 to 25 players with weekly Friday play, and was a tournament director for about a year before joining Red Squadron. Alaska hosted the 1997 Hoth Regional, which Rebel Base Leader [[Allen Divers]] attended.<ref name="decsq-prof" />

== In their own words ==

<blockquote>
The great state of Alaska is included in the Star Wars CCG Hoth tournaments region. Ask Rebel Base Leader [[Allen Divers]], a Texan, about the weather - his first visit to Alaska, for our '97 Hoth Regional, coincided with an early winter storm and the first time he had ever seen it snow.

From personal experience, let me say, do NOT feed the moose unless they are in a cage or you can throw really far.<ref name="decsq-prof" />
</blockquote>

Decipher recruited volunteer Squadron Members in the 1990s to promote SWCCG locally (tournaments, demos, player support). "FL" is printed on some slots in the surviving tables.
